needed.suggestion: Create a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Create a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this junction to allow safe crossing of the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at this junction to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when using the crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at this junction to allow wheelchair users and those with mobility aids to cross the road safely.
Install street lighting along this road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially at night.
